scope: Qualified ngspice 47 DC resistor/capacitor networks, AC RL/RLC responses with uncoupled ideal inductors, analytic first-order RC transient, independent nodal/raw-data verification, Calc handoff and shared document/console reuse. No DC inductors, mutual coupling, nonlinear devices or general transient support. Named DC/AC/RC finite-sample voltage/magnitude/gain requirements, signed worst-condition margins and explicit component variants; unmet requirements block publication and reuse. No continuous-band/time or all-tolerance guarantee. 2026-11-03: linear/decade/octave AC grids with exact native-grid readback, explicit peak/RMS amplitude convention, native source-current/KCL verification, derived branch passive currents and complex powers, input impedance and sampled current/power/phase/dB/loading requirements.
acceptance: Run tools/qualify_ngspice.py on the target executable with Calc; verify analytic network responses, public/human reuse and all native kit probes.

Run tools/qualify_ngspice_performance.py on the target executable with Calc; verify nominal and component-variant pass/unmet outcomes, finite study failures, forged-summary rejection and downstream/reuse gates.

Run tools/qualify_ngspice_characterisation.py for independent RC/RL/RLC electrical identities, logarithmic density variants, passive sign and power conservation, signed performance failure and refreshed-digest source-current tampering.
